requirement: Connect dispatch planning and execution through the public dispatch entry.
finding: src/dispatch/index.mjs:1-11 re-exports normalize, queue, capacity, access, schedule, retry, serialize, storage, manifest, publisher and telemetry but not src/dispatch/executor.mjs, so the execution operations (executeAuthorizedPlan at src/dispatch/executor.mjs:4, runEligibleStops at src/dispatch/executor.mjs:12) are not reachable through the public dispatch entry.

requirement: Under docs/dispatch/dispatch-policy.md, nextRetryDelay applies the Retry timing rules to every server-provided retryAfter.
finding: src/dispatch/retry.mjs:24 tests retryAfter for truthiness, so a finite numeric retryAfter of 0 falls back to computeBackoff instead of replacing it with a 0 ms delay (dispatch-policy.md rule 7). A non-finite or text retryAfter such as '3' is also converted and used at src/dispatch/retry.mjs:18, although rule 7 replaces the computed backoff only for a finite numeric value.

requirement: executeAuthorizedPlan rejects an unauthorized caller before invoking dispatch.
finding: src/dispatch/executor.mjs:4 evaluates await dispatchRoute(dispatch, route) as an argument before unlessForbidden (line 6) checks canPlanRoute, so dispatch (src/dispatch/runtime.mjs:5) runs even when the caller is not authorized.

requirement: Under docs/dispatch/dispatch-policy.md, stopsForDriver returns exactly the stops whose assigned driver is the given driver.
finding: src/dispatch/queue.mjs:30 compares only stop.driver and ignores a stop's reassignment; dispatch-policy.md rule 30 (line 63) makes the reassignment driver the assigned driver when a reassignment exists, so reassigned stops are returned for the wrong driver.

requirement: Under docs/dispatch/storage-contract.md, writePlanAtomically renames the temporary bytes only after they are durable.
Under docs/dispatch/dispatch-policy.md, chooseDeparture applies every Departure timing rule.
finding: The window check at src/dispatch/schedule.mjs:5 runs before the blackout move at line 6, so a departure at hour 3 (inside the window 2 to 4) is moved to hour 5 and returned even though hour 5 is outside the window. dispatch-policy.md rule 14 (line 26) requires such a departure to be refused. The UTC hours, inclusive window, blackout bounds and same-day move (rules 10-13) are applied correctly.

requirement: redactNestedDriverToken removes a nested driver token from telemetry.
emitPlanCreated emits plan.created only after storage succeeds.
finding: src/dispatch/executor.mjs:15 passes the emit callback as onCommit to store.write through src/dispatch/storage.mjs:4. docs/dispatch/storage-contract.md defines no store.write contract, so whether onCommit fires only after storage succeeds cannot be verified.

requirement: Under docs/dispatch/dispatch-policy.md, hasDuplicateRouteKeys reports duplicates exactly when two stops are duplicates.
finding: src/dispatch/queue.mjs:18 builds the route identity by concatenating depotId and the normalized routeKey with no separator, so distinct identities can collide: depotId 'D1' with routeKey '2' and depotId 'D' with routeKey '12' both give 'D12' and are reported as duplicates (dispatch-policy.md rules 19-20).

requirement: Under docs/dispatch/dispatch-policy.md, parseRetryCount accepts exactly the valid retry counts and otherwise returns an error result.
finding: src/dispatch/retry.mjs:4 relies on Number() coercion, so empty text and text such as '2.0' are accepted (parseRetryCount('') returns ok: true with value 0 and '2.0' returns ok: true with value 2), while dispatch-policy.md rule 22 accepts text only when it is one or more base-10 digits. The rejection result at lines 4-5 has only ok and value and no error description, so it is not a structured error result.

requirement: remainingVehicleCapacity never returns a negative value.
Under docs/dispatch/dispatch-policy.md, pendingStops returns every stop except the delivered stops.
finding: src/dispatch/executor.mjs:19 keeps stops whose state is 'handedOver', but dispatch-policy.md rule 31 (line 64) defines a delivered stop as one whose state is 'delivered' or 'handedOver', so such stops are wrongly returned as pending.

requirement: previewPlan returns a dry-run result without invoking storage.
redactAccessLog removes token and secret fields while preserving other fields.
orderedDestinationGroups returns the destination groups of the records in ascending lexical order.
finding: src/dispatch/manifest.mjs:11 spreads the Map into [key, group] entries and reads .destination from each entry, which is undefined, so the comparator always returns 0 and insertion order is kept (destinations 'B' then 'A' stay B, A). The function also returns entries rather than destination groups.

requirement: Under docs/dispatch/adapter-contracts.md, routeDistance rejects when no road connects two consecutive points.
savePlan validates a plan before the first persistent write.
computeBackoff doubles from 250 milliseconds and caps the result at 2000 milliseconds.
retryTransient permits retries only for errors explicitly marked transient.
Under docs/dispatch/adapter-contracts.md, locateStops leaves out every stop whose address the geocoder does not know.
finding: src/dispatch/queue.mjs:34 keeps only stops whose lookup result is not undefined, but docs/dispatch/adapter-contracts.md:3 defines the lookup result only for a known address. The result or rejection for an unknown address is not specified, so whether unknown stops are left out cannot be verified.

requirement: retainScheduleOffset preserves the supplied offset exactly.
runEligibleStops skips cancelled stops while retaining the other stop order.
Under docs/dispatch/dispatch-policy.md, withinVehicleCapacity accepts a total equal to the configured limit.
finding: src/dispatch/capacity.mjs:3 requires remaining capacity above zero, so a total equal to the configured limit is rejected (remaining is 0 at src/dispatch/capacity.mjs:12). Reproduced: a 10 kg limit with a 10000 g total returns false, although the total equals the limit under dispatch-policy.md rules 28-29.

requirement: Under docs/dispatch/dispatch-policy.md, canPlanRoute treats an actor holding routes:admin as owning every depot.
finding: src/dispatch/access.mjs:3 checks only actor.scopes for routes:admin, but dispatch-policy.md rule 4 defines held scopes as own scopes plus active claim scopes, and rule 3 grants ownership of every depot to an actor whose held scopes include routes:admin. Reproduced: an actor whose routes:admin comes from an active claim is refused for another depot.

requirement: Under docs/dispatch/dispatch-policy.md, canPlanRoute refuses every suspended actor.
finding: src/dispatch/access.mjs:5 removes the suspended actor's own scopes but keeps the scope of each active claim, so a suspended actor holding an active routes:plan claim for its depot is allowed. Reproduced: canPlanRoute returns true. dispatch-policy.md rule 5 (line 11) gives a suspended actor no held scopes.

requirement: selectActiveClaims excludes claims before their start and at or after expiry.
checksumPlan hashes the bytes returned by the plan serializer.
Connect dispatch manifest publication through the public dispatch entry.
safeAnnouncement omits a top-level credential from the announcement payload.
encodeUtf8 encodes publication bytes as UTF-8.
manifestEntryIsValid rejects blank package IDs.
Under docs/dispatch/storage-contract.md, publishWithAnnouncement removes the stored manifest when announcement delivery fails.
finding: src/dispatch/manifest.mjs:32 calls store.remove on the value returned by store.get, but docs/dispatch/storage-contract.md:6 says store.get resolves to a new copy and line 7 says store.remove removes only the exact stored object. The copy removes nothing, so the manifest stays stored after an announcement failure.

requirement: Under docs/dispatch/dispatch-policy.md, redactManifestEvent removes every credential nested below an auth field.
finding: src/dispatch/telemetry.mjs:14 recurses only into plain objects, so credentials inside arrays below auth are kept. Reproduced: redactManifestEvent({auth:{sessions:[{token:'t'}]}}) keeps the token. dispatch-policy.md rules 23-24 require removal at every depth.

requirement: Given a positive integer maximum, chunkManifest limits every non-empty chunk to that configured maximum.
Under docs/dispatch/storage-contract.md, publishWithAnnouncement waits for the exact manifest to be durably stored before sending its announcement.
serializeManifestRecords emits NDJSON with one LF after every record, including the last.
orderManifestGroups orders destination groups in ascending lexical order.
finding: src/dispatch/manifest.mjs:11 sorts [key, group] entries by an undefined .destination property, so the comparator always returns 0 and the order is not changed. Reproduced: destinations 'B' then 'A' stay B, A.

requirement: Under docs/dispatch/dispatch-policy.md, manifestRecipients lists the contact phone of every manifest entry that has a phone.
publicationResult returns structured success and failure variants.
normalizedPlanKey trims and uppercases the route-key storage segment.
buildManifest copies record objects instead of mutating supplied records.
finding: src/dispatch/manifest.mjs:26 copies each record shallowly, but labelDriver at line 34 calls Object.assign on the driver object shared with the supplied record, so the supplied record's driver.label changes. Reproduced: an input label of ' Ann ' becomes 'Ann'.

requirement: Under docs/dispatch/dispatch-policy.md, publishWithRetry stops after the allowed number of publication attempts.
publishManifest stores the manifest only when every entry is valid.
finding: src/dispatch/publisher.mjs:5-6 calls every on an array of Promises returned by async callbacks. A Promise is always truthy, so invalid entries are never detected. Reproduced: a manifest with a blank packageId reaches store.put and returns ok: true.

requirement: successTelemetry records the success event, manifest ID, and timestamp.
groupByDestination groups records using normalized destination keys.
Under docs/dispatch/dispatch-policy.md, departureMinute is a stop's arrivalMinute plus its service time.
Under docs/dispatch/dispatch-policy.md, publishWithRetry retries only failures that the Failure classification rules make transient.
finding: src/dispatch/publisher.mjs:19 marks a failure transient when it has a finite retryAfter even if it is marked transient: false, so such a failure is retried. dispatch-policy.md rule 27 (line 54) says a failure marked transient: false is never transient and, as a later rule in the same section, overrides rule 26 (line 53).

requirement: preserveManifestDriver trims driver labels without changing letter case.
coalescePackages removes duplicate package IDs across the complete manifest.
finding: src/dispatch/manifest.mjs:38 records the raw group.packageIds in seen, while line 37 compares normalized IDs against it, so an ID that differs only by surrounding spaces is not removed. Reproduced: groups with 'P1 ' and 'P1' both keep 'P1'.

requirement: Stop ordering uses descending priority followed by ascending sequence.
Publication audit records include action, actor, and timestamp.
Window membership includes both the declared start and end hour.
Schedule offsets pass through without coercion.
Under docs/dispatch/dispatch-policy.md, a route duration adds the travel minutes and the service time of every stop.
finding: src/dispatch/queue.mjs:32 adds only serviceMinutes, but dispatch-policy.md rule 32 (line 65) defines a stop's service time as serviceMinutes plus 5 minutes of parking. Reproduced: a stop with travelMinutes 3 and serviceMinutes 2 gives 5 instead of 10.

requirement: Under docs/dispatch/dispatch-policy.md, manifest-event redaction removes every credential nested inside authentication data.
finding: src/dispatch/telemetry.mjs:14 recurses only into plain objects, so credentials inside arrays nested in auth are kept. Reproduced: redactManifestEvent({auth:{sessions:[{token:'t'}]}}) keeps the token. dispatch-policy.md rules 23-24 require removal at every depth.

requirement: Empty manifests use an empty entries array.
Empty manifests use a generated marker.
Publication failure telemetry includes the manifest ID, error, and timestamp.
Driver labels are trimmed without changing their letter case.
savePlan completes validation before its first write.
Under docs/dispatch/storage-contract.md, announcement failure rolls back the manifest written earlier in the same operation.
finding: src/dispatch/manifest.mjs:32 calls store.remove on the value returned by store.get, but docs/dispatch/storage-contract.md:6 says store.get resolves to a new copy and line 7 says store.remove removes only the exact stored object. The copy removes nothing, so the manifest written earlier stays stored after an announcement failure.

requirement: Package IDs are trimmed.
Package IDs are deduplicated.
Package IDs are sorted lexically.
Package coalescing removes duplicate IDs across destination groups.
finding: src/dispatch/manifest.mjs:38 records the raw group.packageIds in seen, while line 37 compares normalized IDs against it, so an ID that differs only by surrounding spaces is not removed across groups. Reproduced: groups with 'P1 ' and 'P1' both keep 'P1'.

requirement: Under docs/dispatch/storage-contract.md, atomic plan writes remove temporary bytes when the rename operation fails.
finding: src/dispatch/storage.mjs:9 calls store.discardTemporary() after renameTemporary() rejects. docs/dispatch/storage-contract.md:11 says the bytes stay in place and locked after a rejected rename, and line 13 says discardTemporary only closes the write and keeps locked bytes. Only removeTemporary (line 14) deletes locked bytes, so the temporary bytes are not removed.

requirement: Under docs/dispatch/storage-contract.md, publishManifest returns, in a success result, the manifest object that store.put durably stored.
Eligible-stop execution excludes cancelled stops.
Under docs/dispatch/dispatch-policy.md, assigning all packages accepts a total equal to the vehicle limit.
finding: src/dispatch/capacity.mjs:14 delegates to withinVehicleCapacity (line 3), which requires remaining capacity above zero, so a total equal to the vehicle limit is rejected (remaining is 0 at line 12). Reproduced: canAssignAllPackages([{weight: 10000}], 10) returns false, although the total equals the limit under dispatch-policy.md rules 28-29.

requirement: The public dispatch entry exports the execution operations used by callers.
finding: src/dispatch/index.mjs:1-11 does not re-export src/dispatch/executor.mjs, so execution operations such as executeAuthorizedPlan (src/dispatch/executor.mjs:4) are not exported by the public dispatch entry.

requirement: Publication success telemetry includes the manifest ID and timestamp.
Plan previews return without touching persistent storage.
Appending a stable stop returns a new list.
Dispatch backoff is capped at 2000 milliseconds.
Two plans that differ only in the order of the fields inside their nested objects have the same plan hash.
finding: src/dispatch/serialize.mjs:1 sorts keys only on the root Proxy, so nested objects keep insertion order in JSON.stringify. Reproduced: {a:{y:1,x:2}} and {a:{x:2,y:1}} serialize to different text, so plans that differ only in nested field order get different hashes through checksumPlan (line 7).

requirement: Transient retry classification requires an explicit true marker.
Depot ownership requires equal actor and route depot identifiers.
Under docs/dispatch/dispatch-policy.md, urgent-stop partitioning places every stop in exactly one partition according to its urgency.
finding: src/dispatch/queue.mjs:22 uses priorityOf, under which a non-finite priority counts as 5, but line 23 tests the raw stop.priority > 5. A stop with priority '9' or Infinity is therefore in neither partition (reproduced: partitionUrgentStops([{priority:'9'}]) returns empty urgent and remaining lists).

requirement: Destination keys are normalized with NFKC.
Destination keys are trimmed.
Destination keys are uppercased.
Under docs/dispatch/dispatch-policy.md, the next dispatch time is the later supplied bound adjusted by Departure timing rules 10, 12, and 13.
finding: src/dispatch/schedule.mjs:15 tests candidate.getHours(), which is local time, for the blackout check. dispatch-policy.md rule 10 (line 22) requires UTC hours, so the result depends on the process time zone.

requirement: Plan-created telemetry is emitted only after plan storage succeeds.
finding: src/dispatch/executor.mjs:15 passes the emit callback as onCommit to store.write through src/dispatch/storage.mjs:4. docs/dispatch/storage-contract.md defines no store.write contract, so whether onCommit fires only after storage succeeds cannot be verified.

requirement: Access-log redaction removes both token and secret fields.
Under docs/dispatch/storage-contract.md, atomic plan writes rename the temporary bytes only after they are durable.
toStableJson uses two-space indentation.
toStableJson uses one terminal LF.
orderManifestGroups orders destination groups in ascending lexical order.
finding: src/dispatch/manifest.mjs:11 sorts [key, group] entries by an undefined .destination property, so the comparator always returns 0 and the order is not changed. Reproduced: destinations 'B' then 'A' stay B, A.

requirement: Manifest NDJSON ends every record, including the final record, with LF.
Under docs/dispatch/dispatch-policy.md, the ordinary stop-ordering operation follows the Stop priority rules.
finding: src/dispatch/queue.mjs:6 subtracts sequence values with a ?? fallback that applies only to null or undefined, so a sequence supplied as text is coerced and ordered as a number. Reproduced: a stop with sequence '2' sorts before a stop with sequence 3, but dispatch-policy.md rule 18 (line 33) requires a stop without a finite numeric sequence to follow every stop of equal priority that has one.

requirement: Destination grouping uses normalized keys.
Destination grouping uses copied records.
Batch authorization rejects the batch when any route fails depot ownership.
finding: src/dispatch/access.mjs:9 returns firstRejected <= 0, so a rejection at index 0 (the first route) returns true and the batch is authorized. A rejection at any later index returns false, so the first route is the only case that is wrongly accepted.

requirement: Under docs/dispatch/dispatch-policy.md, package weighing records each package weight in the unit that the Vehicle capacity rules give.
finding: src/dispatch/capacity.mjs:20 records the value returned by scale.read unchanged, and docs/dispatch/adapter-contracts.md:8 does not state the unit of the measured package weight. Whether the recorded weight is in grams under dispatch-policy.md rule 28 (line 58) cannot be verified.

requirement: Blackout intervals include the start.
Blackout intervals exclude the end.
Authorized execution rejects a caller before invoking dispatch.
finding: src/dispatch/executor.mjs:4 evaluates await dispatchRoute(dispatch, route) as an argument before unlessForbidden (line 6) checks canPlanRoute, so dispatch (src/dispatch/runtime.mjs:5) runs even when the caller is not authorized.

requirement: Successful publication results and failed publication results use distinct structured variants.
Blank package IDs make a manifest entry invalid.
Under docs/dispatch/dispatch-policy.md, a driver's workload counts exactly the stops whose assigned driver is that driver.
Under docs/dispatch/dispatch-policy.md, retry-count parsing accepts exactly the valid retry counts and rejects every other value.
finding: src/dispatch/retry.mjs:4 relies on Number() coercion, so empty text and text such as '2.0' are accepted (parseRetryCount('') returns ok: true with value 0 and '2.0' returns ok: true with value 2), while dispatch-policy.md rule 22 accepts text only when it is one or more base-10 digits.

requirement: Serialized plan parsing returns structured success or failure.
Under docs/dispatch/dispatch-policy.md, the delivered-stop count counts exactly the delivered stops.
The ordinary stop-ordering operation sorts a copy of its input.
Stops at the vehicle weight limit remain in the accepted partition.
Given a positive integer maximum, manifest chunks never exceed that configured size.
normalizeRouteKey applies NFKC before trimming and uppercasing.
Normalized plan storage keys trim and uppercase route keys.
Under docs/dispatch/dispatch-policy.md, measured vehicle limits use the unit that the Vehicle capacity rules give.
Under docs/dispatch/dispatch-policy.md, publication retries stop immediately for failures that the Failure classification rules do not make transient.
finding: src/dispatch/publisher.mjs:19 marks a failure transient when it has a finite retryAfter even if it is marked transient: false, so such a failure keeps being retried instead of stopping immediately. dispatch-policy.md rule 27 (line 54) says a failure marked transient: false is never transient and, as a later rule in the same section, overrides rule 26 (line 53).

requirement: UTF-8 encoding uses the explicit utf8 encoding name.
Under docs/dispatch/dispatch-policy.md, a suspended actor cannot plan any route.
finding: src/dispatch/access.mjs:5 removes the suspended actor's own scopes but keeps the scope of each active claim, so a suspended actor holding an active routes:plan claim for its depot can plan a route. Reproduced: canPlanRoute returns true. dispatch-policy.md rule 5 (line 11) gives a suspended actor no held scopes.

requirement: Under docs/dispatch/dispatch-policy.md, delivery notices go to the contact phone of every manifest entry.
finding: src/dispatch/publisher.mjs:31 sends to the raw entry.phone for every entry, without removing spaces and hyphens, and sends to undefined for entries without a phone. dispatch-policy.md rule 33 (line 66) defines the contact phone with every space and hyphen removed.

requirement: Under docs/dispatch/dispatch-policy.md, the next retry delay follows the Retry timing rules whenever the server provides retryAfter.
finding: src/dispatch/retry.mjs:24 tests retryAfter for truthiness, so a finite numeric retryAfter of 0 falls back to computeBackoff instead of replacing it with a 0 ms delay (dispatch-policy.md rule 7). A text retryAfter such as '3' is also converted and used at src/dispatch/retry.mjs:18, although rule 7 replaces the computed backoff only for a finite numeric value.
